advice.headline: Make a trade

moves.text: Offer Best in the 🌍: George Pickens for Ashton Jeanty.

reasons: You're 9-2 and make the playoffs in >99% of simulated seasons. Your title chance is 20%.
Your projected playoff-week lineup ranks 3rd of 10 contenders (157.2 points a week).
Your weakest position is TE (6th of 12), so that's where an upgrade helps most.
Looking ahead, your roster projects 2nd in 2026, 2nd in 2027 and 3rd in 2028 (title chances about 20%, 20%, 22%), after aging and the rookies your picks will bring.
Your roster holds up for the next two seasons too, so you can afford to push for titles now.

That trade raises your title chance from 20% to 23%, and your lineup comes out 1.1 points a week ahead overall. George Pickens adds 2.5 points a week for you today, but Ashton Jeanty is worth more to your lineup.
The trade values are close enough for them to say yes (you give 4,353, get 4,350), and it barely changes their lineup (-0.9 a week).
It doesn't cost your future: title chances in the next two seasons go from 20% and 22% to 23% and 22%.
You have 2 weeks until the trade deadline.
